violated_contract: Each green macOS update must enter an immutable candidate no more than once per hour; later main merges must queue for the next train instead of invalidating or starving the current candidate.
canonical_prevention: Bind the candidate to the exact green planner source or a mechanically verified changelog-only child, require that candidate to be reachable from authoritative main, recover stale changelog branches without terminal retries, and age freshness from the oldest unshipped update.
